38: And if you say his body becomes disqualified from eating Terumah, do we feed something that disqualifies his body, after which he would return and eat Terumah along with it? For example, those spices.
"Leave aside the Nezid HaDema (the mixture/stew of Terumah)—for we do not care if he eats Terumah spices during a disqualification of the body."
